## access-approval
Only Maya, and Dana while Maya is away, approve new SaaS seats. Ask in the thread before inviting anyone outside the company.

## digest-format
Monday digest: at most 5 bullets, link each item, no emoji, and post by 10:00. See [[digest-sources]].
